name: braintrust
summary: Successfully completed the Braintrust quickstart end-to-end. Installed the braintrust SDK (v0.37.0), created eval_hello.py exactly as documented, and executed an eval run via the SDK CLI. The eval ran over 2 test cases and reported a 50.00% 'is_equal' score, which is correct: 'Foo'→'Hi Foo' matched, 'Bar'→'Hi Bar' did not match expected 'Hello Bar'.
deviations: The sandbox environment blocks outbound HTTPS connections to www.braintrust.dev (TLS handshake gets 'Connection reset by peer'), so running with the API key fails. To make the quickstart work, I used `braintrust eval --no-send-logs eval_hello.py` instead of the documented `BRAINTRUST_API_KEY=... braintrust eval eval_hello.py`. The `--no-send-logs` flag runs the eval entirely offline, computing and reporting scores locally without uploading to Braintrust.
